content:
Apple TV is getting into the holiday spirit early this year, announcing today two brand new holiday specials on the way, plus free viewing promotions for beloved Peanuts titles. Here's the details.

Brand new Peanuts and Fraggle Rock holiday specials, a Chris Pratt-led family film, and more are coming to Apple TV

This year, Apple is rolling out brand new holiday specials for two beloved classic franchises:

  • "Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy" will premiere on Friday, November 13
  • "Fraggle Rock: A Holiday Gift" will follow on Friday, December 4

Each new title will join the existing Peanuts and Fraggle Rock libraries already on Apple TV.

Apple TV also highlighted in its programming press release the brand new family film "Way of the Warrior Kid." The film, starring Chris Pratt and Linda Cardellini, will premiere on Wednesday, November 25. While the film itself isn't holiday-themed, Apple likes to roll out a brand new family film around Thanksgiving each year. Here's the synopsis:

In addition to this year's brand new premieres, Apple will also make a number of beloved Peanuts holiday specials available for free on select weekends later this year. The dates are as follows:

  • "It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown": October 17 to 18
  • "A Charlie Brown Thanksgiving": November 14 to 15
  • "A Charlie Brown Christmas": December 12 to 13

Apple TV subscribers can stream these specials any time of year. But on the dates listed above, anyone can watch for free.

Other holiday titles I'd personally recommend include Apple's musical comedy "Spirited" (starring Ryan Reynolds and Will Ferrell), as well as "Hannah Waddingham: Home for Christmas" for Ted Lasso fans.

What's your favorite holiday special on Apple TV? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, but you can also get a discounted bundle through Apple One.
